obfuscation_indicators: fluidity limits our ability to predict
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and strongly quantified, highlighting exceptional sales, cash flow, operating income, and ROIC growth. Key risks include COVID-19 uncertainty, volatile sales mix and margins, elevated pandemic-related costs, and reliance on unusually strong demand that may not persist. Some standard management qualifications and non-GAAP measures modestly temper comparability and clarity.
